  (h₀b : ∀ n, b (n + 2) - b (n + 1) = b (n + 1) - b n)
  (h₁ : a 1 = p) (h₂ : a 2 = 9)

  have h : ∀ k, a (k + 1) = b (k + 1) := by
    intro k
    induction' k using Nat.strong_induction_on with k ih
    rcases k with _ | k
    · rw [h₁, hb₁]
    · rcases k with _ | k
      · rw [h₂, hb₂]
      · have h_a : a (k + 3) = 2 * a (k + 2) - a (k + 1) := by
          linarith [h₀a (k + 1)]
        have h_b : b (k + 3) = 2 * b (k + 2) - b (k + 1) := by

  conv_rhs => rw [hn']
  exact h (n - 1)
